originalTitle: Intel says it’s selling every affordable laptop chip it can make

content: During Intel’s latest earnings call, CEO Lip-Bu Tan said that demand for its budget-focused Wildcat Lake chips “is outstripping supply.” According to CFO David Zinsner, the chips are now sold out. Zinsner said Intel has “seen significant growth in Wildcat Lake. It’s coming exactly at the right time because it’s cost-optimized and we’re seeing a lot of focus in that regard.” As shortages of RAM and other components have driven up PC prices over recent months, Intel’s Wildcat Lake chips have been appearing in new lower-cost Windows laptops on par with the MacBook Neo, like the new Dell XPS 13 or the HP Omnibook 5 14. Wildcat Lake laptops like these have budget-friendly starting prices, but often with just 8GB of RAM, which Windows laptops can struggle to get by on. Intel doesn’t expect the memory shortage to improve any time soon. Zinsner responded to a question about memory supply, saying, “Make no mistake, we are not optimistic about next year in terms of memory.” He added, “we’ll, you know, have to see in ‘28 whether things improve, but our expectation is that it does not improve in ‘27.” That’s more optimistic than SK Hynix’s prediction that the RAM shortage will drag on through 2030. Tan also acknowledged the PC demand slowdown, saying, “The industry continues to navigate one of the most significant supply shortages in the [sic] history, driven by the unprecedented demand for super intelligence,” referring to AI. Zinsner went on to respond to a question during the earnings call, saying, “We do think the PC is going to go through a renaissance despite this.”

chineseContent: 在英特尔最新的财报电话会议上，首席执行官 Lip-Bu Tan 表示，对其预算型 Wildcat Lake 芯片的需求“正在供不应求”。首席财务官 David Zinsner 表示，这些芯片现已售罄。 Zinsner 表示，英特尔“看到了 Wildcat Lake 的显着增长。它的出现恰逢其时，因为它进行了成本优化，而且我们在这方面看到了很多关注。”近几个月来，由于 RAM 和其他组件的短缺推高了 PC 价格，英特尔的 Wildcat Lake 芯片已经出现在与 MacBook Neo 相当的新型低成本 Windows 笔记本电脑中，例如新款戴尔 XPS 13 或 HP Omnibook 5 14。此类 Wildcat Lake 笔记本电脑的起价很实惠，但通常只有 8GB 内存，Windows 笔记本电脑很难承受。英特尔预计内存短缺问题不会很快得到改善。 Zinsner 在回答有关内存供应的问题时表示，“毫无疑问，我们对明年的内存并不乐观。”他补充道，“你知道，我们必须看看 28 年情况是否有所改善，但我们的预期是 27 年情况不会改善。”这比 SK Hynix 预测 RAM 短缺将持续到 2030 年更为乐观。Tan 还承认 PC 需求放缓，他表示，“在对超级智能前所未有的需求的推动下，该行业继续应对历史上最严重的供应短缺之一”，他指的是人工智能。津斯纳在财报电话会议上回答了一个问题，他说：“尽管如此，我们确实认为个人电脑将迎来复兴。”
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
